fields.description: Binghatti Vintage brings studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments to Majan. Its shared recreation spaces sit below a tall residential composition, while several larger apartment drawings include their own pool terrace. Outdoor proportions vary widely, making the individual plan more useful than a single project-wide size claim.

overview: The brochure lists 1,572 residences and 36 residential floors, with basements, mezzanine, podium and service levels described separately.
Private pools appear in selected one- and two-bedroom drawings. Their terraces form part of the advertised total; they are not additional interior rooms or a universal inclusion.
research.locationNote: Majan, Dubai. Binghatti identifies access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Dubai–Al Ain Road. Confirm the selected unit’s access, orientation and outlook.
research.priceNote: The own page displays AED 674999. Property Finder rounds its launch reference to AED 675000 and marks developer units sold out, while Binghatti retains an Available flag. Neither establishes currently available Aliyas stock or a specific quotation.
research.paymentNote: Historical broker-hosted calendar: 10% down, 50% across construction and 40% final. Its 30% completion header conflicts with the table; a 14% booking banner is unexplained. Property Finder corroborates the overall split. Confirm current terms rather than applying the old dates to a new purchase.
research.handoverNote: The calendar ends 31 March 2027, matching Property Finder’s month estimate. No current dated developer commitment or handover evidence was retrieved.
